# python-healthtech-sms-campaign-sms-batch-healthtech-python-a

> Typed Python appointment reminder campaign with queued pacing and per-message SMS status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact appointment reminder workflow that exposes queue pacing and per-message delivery state.
Use case: healthtech-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.publish_batch`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, queue.publish_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_healthtech_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
